ios.desc:
A joyful sudoku-solving experience built natively for iPhone and iPad and optimized for a zen solving experience free from bloat and distraction. Designed to be easy to play and meet you where ever you are in your sudoku journey: a casual solver or a sudoku pro. Stuck on a puzzle? Shake your phone for hints and turn on move by move validation in settings to get immediate feedback on your solve. Tickle your brain as you learn new solving strategies and customize the app to your taste with themes and alternate app icons.

Play a daily puzzle at a difficulty of your choice and see where you stack up with players across the globe. Or just turn off the stopwatch and relax.

Key features:
- Fully offline: no internet required
- No ads or distractions
- Real-time move validation to get immediate feedback
- Shake for a hint on the next logical move
- Leaderboards with assist tracking
- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
- Light/Dark mode
- Stopwatch and best time tracking
- Notes: Keep track of candidates
- Auto-clear Notes: removes candidate numbers automatically in row, column, and box when they become outdated
- Speed demon: Lock numbers and place them in multiple tiles at once
- Arithmophobia: Sudoku with letters instead of numbers
- Daily streak tracking
- Daily reminder notifications
- Highlighter: tap a number to highlight all its instances on the board
- Themes to customize the interface (some require Pro)
- Alternate app icons (Pro)
- Charts and statistics (Pro): track solve speed over time and puzzle count by difficulty

Play the daily puzzle at your preferred difficulty for free without any limits on assists or game features. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time purchase to unlock unlimited games, detailed stats, more themes, and alternate app icons. Pro supports Family Sharing.

quotes.text:
I don't mind ads. I really don't. A banner ad here or there is totally fine by me.

But, most of the games on the app store are filled with ads to such an extent that it's ridiculous. These apps are literally unusable.

Back in February 2022, I wanted to make sudoku a daily habit and as most people would, I looked up "sudoku" on the App Store and downloaded the top result.

It was so terrible that it blew my mind. Every few moves I had to watch a video ad. Every few MOVES not every few games. This is on top of a banner ad that's constantly playing at the bottom. How are you supposed to play a game without chucking your phone out the window? Even if you sort the reviews of this app by most favorable the results are mostly negative, complaining about the ads, but it still has 4.5 stars  .

So, as any self-respecting developer would, I built my own. It's clean, ad-free and minimalistic. You can find it here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/not-evil-sudoku/id1614071642.
